data.exact_reserve_text: During 2022 the Syndicate released $85.9m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2021: $105.2m), arising predominantly from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions (2021: predominantly from the Treaty, Marine and Energy divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2022.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of $2,896.5m and recorded a net release on prior years of $85.9m (approximately 2.97% of opening gross reserves). The release arose predominantly from favourable claims development in Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions. The reserves movement is disclosed in the Movement in prior year's provision note and is supported by the claims development table and event-specific estimates (notably prior year natural catastrophe and pandemic-related exposures).

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). The prior year development figure (-85.9) is taken from the Movement in prior year's provision narrative and assumed to be a gross figure as stated. The claims development triangle is available (gross) and could be used as cross-check; note that an RITC of Syndicate 2088 (RITC premium $95.0m) was recorded in 2022 which may distort premium and development patterns in some tables. Field names use 'gbp_m' per requested schema but values are in USD millions (native currency).
